segments.text: An Attempt to render Mr. LAW’s Serious Call more useful to the Children of GOD, by excluding whatever is not truly Evangelical, and illustrating the subject more fully from the Holy Scriptures.
He hath chosen us in Him before the foundation of the world, that we should be holy and without blame before Him in love. Ephesians i. 4.

LAW GOSPELIZED;
OR, AN
ADDRESS to all CHRISTIANS
CONCERNING
HOLINESS of HEART and LIFE.
